title: Curate, explained: the voiceover
source: Round-2 explainer script (marketing/videos tracker, entry "explainer"; copy in tracker/legacy/status.js). Opening timings from the ExOpen motion test (ads/_legacy/remotion-src/mt/ExOpen.tsx); the rest from the storyboard's time codes.

scenes.title: The problem
scenes.picture: A wall of Emma's pieces that keeps shuffling and never lands; a clock at 8:02; 'Nothing to wear.' The pile blows out on the music's swell.

scenes.title: Meet Zee
scenes.picture: Zee's hello lands on the swell, then a few moods; 'Meet Zee.'

scenes.title: Your wardrobe, from your photos
scenes.picture: Her camera roll on the phone; her photo pops out big; the white tee lifts out of it; 'Already in your photos.'

scenes.title: Privacy, the selfie and the scan
scenes.picture: 0:30 the privacy shield with Zee peeking; 0:36 the selfie ring draws on; 0:44 scan dots and a white outline trace a piece; 0:50 one photo up big, a piece pops out, Zee names it.

scenes.title: Pure-float pieces
scenes.picture: The Wardrobe tab, pieces floating and bobbing; one opens up big.

scenes.title: Chat with Zee
scenes.picture: The question typed; Zee's thinking lines; a question card; the look lands as a flash then a tilted print; Adjust; the Style notes.

scenes.title: Weather and location
scenes.picture: The foggy-window location ask, Apple's popup, the look card's weather line ('58°F · Rain at 4').

scenes.title: Try-ons
scenes.picture: The Try-ons tab, her photo plus two pieces, the curtain, the result; she rises out of her selfie in look 1, then look 2.

scenes.title: Tell me when it's ready
scenes.picture: The pieces wait with the pill, the notification permission, the push on the lock screen.

scenes.title: Outro
scenes.picture: A stroke draws round the frame; the Curate logo, 'Your closet, styled by Zee.', the App Store badge; Zee waves.

lines.text: You've got a closet full of clothes.
And somehow, every morning, it's the same thing: nothing to wear.
Meet Zee. She's your stylist.
She lives in Curate, she learns your closet, and she's always up early.
First, Zee needs to see what you own.
No photo shoots, no typing.
Your clothes are already in your photos, because you wear them.
Zee asks before she looks.
You take one selfie, so she knows which one is you.
Then she finds you in your photos, and your pieces start arriving, one by one.
Every piece comes out clean, floating on its own, like a product photo of your actual clothes.
Now ask Zee anything.
“What do I wear to dinner on Friday?”
You can watch her think: she checks the weather, looks through your closet, and makes her calls.
If she needs something only you know, she just asks.
Then your look lands.
Want it more relaxed? Tap Adjust.
Curious why it works? Open the Style notes.
Zee dresses you for the weather where you are.
She'll ask once to use your location, or you can just tell her your city.
Not sure? See it on you first.
Pick a photo of you, pick your pieces, and Try-ons shows you wearing the look.
lines.spoken: Pick a photo of you, pick your pieces, and Try ons shows you wearing the look.

lines.text: Good things take a minute.
Tap “Tell me when it's ready”, put your phone down, and Zee will let you know.
Curate. Your closet, styled by Zee.
Get it on the App Store.
